frozen.size: P = max_j |phi(s_j)| on s_j = j/200, j < 200, of the chord twin with M = 40 terms (pade_twin_size.py's chord basis and #670's errors, F = 1), minimised exactly subject to chi <= 1; bracket [P_lo, P_hi] from an explicit twin and a dual bound; targets chord2, arcjump, arc; n = 23, 31; every node
frozen.planted: selftest: (1) a rotated separable problem with weights 1e-30..1e30, P* = max_k (|b_k| - 1)/s_k = 3.1; (2) the Chebyshev problem on a grid holding the extrema of T_10, P* = (1 - 1/S) 2^-9 with S = 100; each with P_hi and P_lo within 1e-6 relative of P*, P_lo <= P* (1 + 1e-12), P_hi >= P* (1 - 1e-12), and the explicit twin's chi <= 1. (3) #670's planted 8-term chord density at wf 1.00, n = 23: P_lo <= P_hi <= its own peak, P_hi / P_lo - 1 <= 0.01, chi <= 1 + 1e-6 at 250 digits. --mutate=radius (polydisc radius 1.05), --mutate=noproj (lambda not projected) and --mutate=dual (the bound's residual term dropped) each make the selftest fail
frozen.P_gap: P_hi / P_lo - 1 <= 0.01 for every target, n and node
frozen.P_valid: P_lo <= P_hi (1 + 1e-12); the explicit twin's chi recomputed at 250 digits with the 250-digit basis <= 1 + 1e-6; and P_lo recomputed at 250 digits from the same lambda within 1e-6 relative
frozen.P0_calibration: chord2's smallest twin within 10% of chord2's own peak P_own (its 6-term density): P_lo >= 0.9 P_own and P_hi <= 1.1 P_own, at n = 23 and 31 and every node
frozen.mutation_peak: --mutate=scale (chord2's sigma_k x 0.75, its errors kept) must make P0 fail at every n and node; the run exits 1
frozen.separation: the factor-3 rule of 8.2: at n = 31, rho_hi = P_hi(arcjump) / P_lo(chord2) and rho_lo = P_lo(arcjump) / P_hi(chord2). If rho_hi <= 3 at every node, no peak prior separates them (the answer); if rho_lo > 3 at every node, a peak prior of factor 3 separates them; otherwise mixed. n = 23 is reported the same way
frozen.peak_real: only if P_gap, P_valid and P0 pass and rho_lo > 3 at every node at n = 23: the real series' smallest peak chord twin at n = 23, rho_real = P(real) / P(chord2) per node, read against 3; otherwise no real run
frozen.context: the same minimisation on s = j/1000 with the separation rule and chord2's ratio to its own peak there; each twin's peak on s = j/2000, coefficient norm and largest |c_m|; the number of active constraints; the plant arc's ratio; arcjump against chord2's own peak; M = 50 at wf 1.00; reported, not judged
